builder_plan.scenario: A narrow, repeated product task may not need your largest model.
builder_plan.change: Check whether a released student model fits the task before generating training data.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current model and an off-the-shelf small model on the same held-out tasks.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Student quality, serving cost, teacher calls, training cost, and failures on unusual inputs.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: RECAST: REconstruction of Chain-of-Thought via Auditable Structured Traces
summary: It replaces direct CoT extraction and manual rationale writing by generating answer-conditioned synthetic reasoning traces for SFT. Cost is inference spend and engineering for generation, cleaning, filtering, and validation, with added dataset-governance overhead. It can fail through rationale hallucination, answer-rationalization rather than faithful reasoning, benchmark leakage, and terms-of-use or policy constraints on model-generated training data.
rationale: The method is feasible with API access and a small team, but the abstract reports artifact validation rather than downstream quality gains, so production adoption should wait for workload-specific evaluation.
technique: CoT reconstruction from final answers for distillation
